lots.question_for_armitage: Does it run and keep time when wound? Is the crown signed with the Rolex/Tudor mark? Can you read the reference and serial stamped on the caseback or between the lugs? Has the dial been refinished?

lots.working: keep: lowest close SOLD that matches the ring-plus-band format is Gowans 435377 at $190 hammer (a lesser yellow pair, so conservative); 190 / 1.22 = 155.7, round down to $155. The $70-110 singles carry far fewer diamonds than this set, so they are category only. flip: likely resale about $250 hammer locally (between $190 pair and $340 cluster ring), less about 17.5% seller commission and fees = $206, no postage (sold locally); 206 / 2.44 = 84.4, round down to $80. Both apply ONLY if the rings are stamped 9ct (or higher) gold; if unmarked or silver, do not bid.
